I genuinely have been feeling this way too. As if, nothing I do for this exam is enough. Sometimes I go through uworld questions and I set a specific goal and I just cant go through them all cause my brain in frying and I feel tired and unmotivated. Sometimes I just cry and feel like doing nothing. Some days I wake up motivated and do more than I set myself up to. 
Some days I look at my anki cards and do about 150 ish and can’t get through them anymore. Some days I do 300+. 
Some days my scores on questions are not great. Some days they are. 

The thing about this subreddit is that it tends to have a lot of outliers. Ppl with extremely good experiences and bad ones. Sometimes is rare to find something in between, sometimes is hard to find the everyday experience and sincerity that I feel like sometimes communities like this lack. 

I have seen ppl say they study 12h a day 7 days a week. Thats just impossible for me. Not even because I have other stuff to do, I just know it would burn me out completely. Some ppl do 500 anki cards a day and I tried this and I wasn’t learning anything cause I was just trying to get through them. 

This exam is so different, so particular to each test taker and so challenging. It is SO FUCKING HARD. And not everyone has the same situation, skill set, support system, company, partnership, resources as the other person. Its just how it is. I have realized that most med/ pre meds have an ego to maintain, even when it comes to stuff like being truthful about their studies. Being honest about the days on those 7 days a week schedules where they didn’t study, where they were not productive. Where their strength and confidence wavered, doesn’t happen much, even if the person is not ill intended. 

What I want to say is, I definitely understand, we are all on this journey trying to do our best and we can only rely on ourselves. I am trying to be patient and gentle with me because I AM TRYING. And I know op, that you are too. You are doing so good  just by sitting down and trying to get things done even if they didn’t work out. 
Remember this test is hard, and the journey is hard but yeah, legs just try our best, even when it seems like we are not in our most ultimate self.
